ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: None of your 22 copy ads carries a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing to weigh against the claims. Collect one number, like a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
0 of 22 copy ads mention an offer, so a new buyer has no price reason to order today. Open three new ads with a first order offer or a two pack bundle, and make it the first line of each.

9 ads have run 60 days or more, yet none of the 21 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opening line and changing only the product angle.

12 different openings across 22 copy ads, and the biggest opens 5, so no story gets enough repetition to build on. Pick the kitten story and the cat decides story, and build the next batch from them, three ads each.
